text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED oncall: High error-rate for ACME (enterprise, VPC) streaming connections — repeated timeouts & client retries observed. Root ts 3168002468.
elena: oncall acked, looking. can someone paste the gateway logs?
maria: grabbing logs now from rdw-vpc-gw-us-east-2 for tenant acme. seeing a lot of WS close frames + 502/504 at the proxy layer.
sahil: i'm on infra. initial metric: connection error rate jumped at 08:12 UTC, sustained for ~8m, 35-45% of streaming sessions failing to establish or dropping mid-stream.
elena: impact severity? customer reports degraded UX in production.
maria: impact estimate: ~3.2k connect attempts/min for ACME, success rate down to ~60% vs 98% baseline. Affected region: us-east-2.
acme_app_ops: confirming, internal dashboards show reconnect storms, our client SDK retries aggressively which amplifies the problem.
jordan: possible causes: upstream timeout config mismatch or websocket proxy pconn exhaustion — also seeing increased WS queue latency on the dedicated pool router.
elena: is ACME on a dedicated pool?
sahil: yes — rdw-dedicated-us-east-2-acme-1. Pool shows high accept queue and kernel drops on proxy side. GPU workers still healthy.
maria: log snippet:
```
[08:14:23] gw-proxy ERROR connection=acme/conn-9f3f close_code=1006 proxy_err=timeout backend=rdw-svc stream_id=0
[08:14:23] gw-proxy WARN accept_queue=128 drop=12 conn_latency_ms=420
[08:14:24] rdw-svc DEBUG kvcache hit=false client_retry=3
```
elena: action plan (short): 1) throttle client retries via ingress policy for ACME, 2) temporarily increase websocket idle and handshake timeouts on gateway, 3) scale proxy instances for dedicated pool and enable graceful draining, 4) coordinate with ACME to reduce aggressive reconnect behavior.
maria: starting config change: bump proxy.max_handshake_ms to 12000 and ws.ping_interval to 25s for tenant acme. applying to canary instance now.
incident-bot: change set initiated by maria at 3168002589, CI/CD run id run-5941.
sahil: scaling proxy +1 instance to dedicated pool, applying sticky routing to keep sessions on warmed proxies.
elena: pages to product-support for customer comms. @acme_app_ops please hold for a short window while we test canary.
acme_app_ops: copy. we'll pause aggressive client retries on our side and push a client-side patch to 2s backoff.
jordan: monitoring canary — handshake failures dropped from 42% -> 12% in the canary shard after timeout bump. connections stable for 90s.
elena: good. rolling config to remaining proxies in 3m if no regression.
maria: rolling now to 5 nodes. watch logs.
incident-bot: automated alert: downstream retry storms detected; suppressed duplicate pages for 5m.
sahil: added temporary ingress rule to limit per-IP reconnects to 8/min for tenant acme to avoid thundering-herd. Will remove after stabilization.
elena: handoff in 20m to sahil (infra) for mitigation ops, then to jordan for postmortem. sahil you're on call next.
sahil: acked, taking over at 3168002800. I'll keep the channel updated every 10 min.
acme_app_ops: noticing client success rate improving; by our numbers success moved to 92% after the changes. thank you.
jordan: will capture timeline and config diffs for postmortem. preliminary RCA: proxy accept queue saturation + aggressive client retries triggering retry storm; effective mitigation was timeout tuning + rate-limiting retries + scaling proxies.
elena: customer impact assessment: enterprise ACME experienced degraded streaming for ~12m, partial mitigation at +6m, full mitigation at +14m. No data loss, but UX degraded for some sessions.
maria: runbook refs: https://internal.redwood/docs/runbooks/vpc-gateway-streaming.md (see section "tenant retry storms").
elena: next steps: 1) postmortem draft (jordan), 2) add automated detection playbook for rapid retry storm throttling (maria + sahil), 3) follow-up with ACME support sync (maria).
acme_app_ops: appreciated. we'll schedule a 1:1 to align client retry defaults.
jordan: tagging for postmortem: incident-3168002468, will include traffic graphs + log excerpts.
elena: closing active mitigation window. handoff complete to sahil at 3168002800. set status to monitoring. :thumbsup:
sahil: monitoring continues, will escalate if any relapse.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status=monitoring, severity=sev2, incident_id=3168002468, last_update=3168002880.
